::: {.cells columns="1fr 2fr" gutter="70pt"}

::: {.cell}
::: {.lede}
Paid students contribute to research and build RSE skills while they do it.
:::

Campuses need more data and software help than staff can provide. Students want this experience, but their courses can't cover everything. DataSquads fill this gap.
:::

# What the work looks like

::: {.carleton}
**Election-news scraper.** One student built it, six improved it in 2022, and two more extended it from 2023 to 2024 for a political science project that set out to scrape over 500,000 transcripts. Their changes made long runs faster and easier to resume.

```{=typst}
#scraper-visual()
```
:::

```{=typst}
#heli-example[*Police helicopter flight data.* Two students brought software skills to a research lab's R code. They refactored it with staff, and the code went through code review. Loading the data fell from about 318 minutes to about 2.]
```

**Student contributions to research software.** Students started wbcheck ([doi:10.5281/zenodo.23329531](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23329531)) and contributed to the UC OSPO Education site ([doi:10.5281/zenodo.23330022](https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.23330022)). Staff expanded wbcheck in 2026 with AI assistance. Depending on project needs, we add run instructions, dependency documentation, tests, and citation files.
:::

# What adopting takes

Adapt this for your environment! You'll need:

- Students and a wage budget
- To care about developing novices
- Patience

::: {.startbox}
# Start a DataSquad

::: {.cells columns="1fr 2.2in" gutter="30pt"}

::: {.cell}
Get the starter kit for roles, onboarding, confidentiality, and request tracking. Students learn software sharing from our open lesson, [Sharing Research Software](https://ucospo.net/research-software-citable-discoverable/). We can help with supervising students: onboarding, review, attrition, expectations.

::: {.url}
[datasquad.info/join](https://datasquad.info/join)
